UNIVERSITAS BUNDA MULIA
INFORMATION BOOKLET
Located in Jakarta and Tangerang, Indonesia’s vibrant
capital city, Universitas Bunda Mulia (UBM) welcomes
international students to experience academic excellence
combined with cultural diversity and warmth.
This booklet provides essential information for students
joining our Student Exchange Program — from application
procedures, academic structure, and daily life,
to your first arrival in Indonesia.

Indonesia has a tropical climate, with two main seasons: 
• Dry Season: May – October 
• Rainy Season: November – April 
Average temperature ranges between 27°C – 32°C.
Light clothing is recommended throughout the year.
Jakarta (UBM) follows GMT +7
(Western Indonesia Time)

VISA & Stay Perm/i_t
UBM will assist international students in processing both Study Permit, Student Visa (VITAS), and Limited Stay Permit (KITAS).
Estimated Cost (Visa & KITAS Processing) IDR   12,000,000 (including administrative processing)
Step 1: Study Permit Application Process
UBM will support and submit your Study Permit application to
the Ministry of Education. Required documents from the student:
• English-translated Academic Transcript
• Certificate of Enrollment from Home University
• Statement Letter
• Police Criminal Record Certificate
• Passport Scan (main information page)
Step 2: Student Visa & KITAS Processing
After Study Permit approval, UBM will process your Visa (VITAS)
& later KITAS upon arrival in Indonesia. Required documents from
the student:
• Color Scanned Passport (front information page)
• English-translated Graduation Certificate & Academic Transcript
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Indonesian Residential Address during stay
• Photo 4x6 (red background)
• Approved Study Permit
All incoming exchange students are required to arrange their own international health insurance
that is valid in Indonesia for the entire duration of their study. The insurance must cover medical
treatment, hospitalization, and emergency care.

A/r_rival Guide
Welcome to Indonesia! Here are some helpful steps to ensure
a smooth arrival and transition to your new life at UBM:
ARRIVAL AT AIRPORT
Most international flights arrive at Soekarno-Hatta
International Airport (CGK) in Tangerang,
approximately: 
• 45–60 minutes to UBM Ancol Campus 
TRANSPORTATION OPTIONS
• Airport Taxi: Official Blue Bird or Golden Bird counters
 available at all terminals 
• Airport Train: Available from Terminal 2 & 3
 (to BNI City Station, Central Jakarta) 
• Ride-Hailing Apps: Gojek or Grab (download before arrival)

ORIENTATION & REGISTRATION
UBM will hold an Orientation Session for all exchange students within
the first week of the semester. During orientation, you will receive:
• Student ID card
• Class schedule
• Campus tour
• Information on student clubs and activities
• Smiling and greetings (“Selamat pagi /Selamat
 siang / Selamat sore”) are appreciated.
• Dress modestly on campus.
• It’s polite to use both hands when giving or
 receiving something.
